definitions: Any of a group of enzymes that catalyze the transfer of a phosphoribosyl group from 5-phosphoribosyl 1-pyrophosphate to an acceptor molecule, often in the biosynthesis of nucleotides.
examples: The activity of phosphoribosyltransferase was measured.
Defects in phosphoribosyltransferase can lead to certain metabolic disorders.
Many biosynthetic pathways involve a phosphoribosyltransferase.
